snippet.title: Thief's Adventure - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3877520/Thiefs_Adventure/
https://razamat.itch.io/thiefs-adventure

A tactical stealth game set in a gritty medieval fantasy world. Sneak past guards, loot valuables, and take down key targets. Being spotted means death.
